plan_review.notes: Independent plan review confirmed the reserve-threading design. It identified a direct returning-to-abandoned unit-test gap; resolved by asserting the intent first returns without the reserve and then abandons when the reserve is supplied.

independent_grade.notes: The implementation successfully resolves the intent/execution mismatch by threading the merchant weapon reserve into updateSpellBrokerIntent and applying it exclusively to repeat purchases. The fix prevents returning-to-abandoned loops while preserving initial spell purchase priorities. The diff is surgically scoped, comprehensively covered by targeted unit tests and a headless regression seed case, and fully compliant with project policies (handoff, review ledger, and apple tracking are all present and accurate).
